scripts.mobile: npm run shared:build && npm --workspace=welyt-mobile run start
scripts.mobile:web: npm run shared:build && npm --workspace=welyt-mobile run web
scripts.mobile:export:check: npm run shared:build && npm --workspace=welyt-mobile run export:check
scripts.api: npm run shared:build && npm --workspace=welyt-api run dev
scripts.api:build: npm run shared:build && npm --workspace=welyt-api run build
scripts.api:test: npm run shared:build && npm --workspace=welyt-api run test
scripts.api:db:migrate: npm run shared:build && npm --workspace=welyt-api run db:migrate
